name: inventory-grid
title: Inventory Grid
description: TurtleDeck's inventory: square slots on a faint grid with beveled item swatches, short names and stack counts. The selected slot gets an orange border and the arrow keys move it.
usage:
<InventoryGrid aria-label="Turtle inventory" defaultValue={0}>
  <InventorySlot name="Cobble" count={64} color="#8b8f88" />
  <InventorySlot />
</InventoryGrid>
notes: The grid uses role=grid with one tab stop. Arrow keys move the selection, Home and End jump to the ends of a row, and Ctrl+Home or Ctrl+End jump to the first or last slot.
Set columns to change the width, for example columns={9} for a chest, and size="sm" to hide item names for tight layouts. Use value and onValueChange to control the selection.
